spec.description: Query planner and row-execution view for hydradb. Mixed Prometheus + ClickHouse: the plan fields live only on the 'query plan warrants attention' warning line, so ClickHouse supplies the numerator and Prometheus the denominator for every ratio. Only graph_client_operation_*_duration_seconds and graph_query_rows_duration_microseconds are histograms; every other graph_*_microseconds metric is a counter of summed duration and yields averages only.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time,
       attributes['hydradb.query.access_path'] AS access_path,
       count() / $__interval_s AS warnings
FROM cortex.cortex_logs_v2_distributed
WHERE environment = 'staging'
  AND service_name IN ('hydradb-graph-node', 'hydradb-graph-indexer')
  AND k8s_namespace = '$namespace'
  AND mapContains(attributes, 'hydradb.query.access_path')
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY time, access_path
ORDER BY time

spec.description: Grouped by `hydradb.query.access_path`. A single series is a real finding, not a broken panel — this is the panel that shows the shape changing.
spec.title: Access path distribution

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time,
    quantile(0.50)(
        toFloat64(attributes['planning_elapsed_ms'])
    ) AS p50,
    quantile(0.90)(
        toFloat64(attributes['planning_elapsed_ms'])
    ) AS p90,
    quantile(0.99)(
        toFloat64(attributes['planning_elapsed_ms'])
    ) AS p99
FROM cortex.cortex_logs_v2_distributed
WHERE environment = 'staging'
  AND service_name = 'hydradb-graph-node'
  AND k8s_namespace = '$namespace'
  AND mapContains(attributes, 'planning_elapsed_ms')
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

spec.description: Quantiles computed in ClickHouse over `planning_elapsed_ms`. Only warned queries are logged, so this is the planning cost of the slow path, not of all queries.
spec.title: Planning latency

spec.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time,
       attributes['hydradb.query.optimizer_passes'] AS optimizer_passes,
       count() / $__interval_s AS warnings
FROM cortex.cortex_logs_v2_distributed
WHERE environment = 'staging'
  AND service_name IN ('hydradb-graph-node', 'hydradb-graph-indexer')
  AND k8s_namespace = '$namespace'
  AND mapContains(attributes, 'hydradb.query.access_path')
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY time, optimizer_passes
ORDER BY time

spec.description: `hydradb.query.optimizer_passes` is a comma-separated list of passes that fired, not a count. `FullScanFallback` appears in every warned plan.
spec.title: Optimizer pass combinations

spec.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time,
       sum(toFloat64OrNull(attributes['hydradb.query.rows_estimated'])) / $__interval_s AS "rows estimated"
FROM cortex.cortex_logs_v2_distributed
WHERE environment = 'staging'
  AND service_name IN ('hydradb-graph-node', 'hydradb-graph-indexer')
  AND k8s_namespace = '$namespace'
  AND mapContains(attributes, 'hydradb.query.access_path')
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

spec.description: Log scale, because the two differ by orders of magnitude. The gap is planner misestimation: estimates are a flat 1,000,000 per warned query while the engine returns a few hundred rows per batch.
spec.title: Rows estimated vs rows returned

The flag is a string in the attributes map, because Vector stringifies every value it buckets, so this compares against 'true' rather than casting to bool.

spec.description: `graph_client_prepare_duration_microseconds` is a counter of summed duration, not a histogram — rate over rate gives an average and no percentile is available.
spec.title: Average prepare duration

spec.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time,
       replaceRegexpAll(error_message, ' key [^ ]+$', '') AS error_class,
       count() / $__interval_s AS errors
FROM cortex.cortex_logs_v2_distributed
WHERE environment = 'staging'
  AND service_name IN ('hydradb-graph-node', 'hydradb-graph-indexer')
  AND k8s_namespace = '$namespace'
  AND message = 'Bolt suppressed internal graph error'
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY time, error_class
ORDER BY time

spec.description: Graph errors the Bolt layer swallowed before the client saw them, so they never reach `graph_query_failed`. The text comes from the `error_message` column, not the attributes map: the call site writes `error = %error`, and `error` is a promoted span field. The idempotency key is stripped from the message to keep the series count bounded.
spec.title: Suppressed Bolt query errors

spec.rawSql:
SELECT attributes['hydradb.query.access_path'] AS access_path,
       attributes['hydradb.query.optimizer_passes'] AS optimizer_passes,
       k8s_pod_name AS pod,
       count() AS warnings,
       round(quantile(0.50)(toFloat64OrNull(attributes['planning_elapsed_ms'])), 2) AS planning_p50_ms,
       round(quantile(0.99)(toFloat64OrNull(attributes['planning_elapsed_ms'])), 2) AS planning_p99_ms,
       max(toFloat64OrNull(attributes['hydradb.query.rows_estimated'])) AS rows_estimated,
       max(timestamp) AS last_seen
FROM cortex.cortex_logs_v2_distributed
WHERE environment = 'staging'
  AND service_name IN ('hydradb-graph-node', 'hydradb-graph-indexer')
  AND k8s_namespace = '$namespace'
  AND mapContains(attributes, 'hydradb.query.access_path')
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY access_path, optimizer_passes, pod
ORDER BY warnings DESC
LIMIT 50

spec.description: One row per (access path, optimizer passes, pod). This is the list to work down when fixing full scans. Tenant attribution may now be available — `hydradb.tenant_id` is recorded on the `client.query` span and promotes to the `tenant_id` column, and `query.plan` is a child of that span — but it is unverified against live data, so no tenant column is selected here yet.
spec.title: Top query shapes

spec.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time,
       countIf(attributes['hydradb.query.full_scan'] = 'true') / $__interval_s AS "full scans"
FROM cortex.cortex_logs_v2_distributed
WHERE environment = 'staging'
  AND service_name IN ('hydradb-graph-node', 'hydradb-graph-indexer')
  AND k8s_namespace = '$namespace'
  AND mapContains(attributes, 'hydradb.query.access_path')
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

spec.description: Both series in queries per second. The gap between them is the headroom; when they converge every query is falling back to a full scan.
spec.title: Full-scan warnings vs total query rate
